passages.text: These are the statutes and ordinances you must be careful to follow all the days you live in the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He is the God of your fathers.
The LORD has given you this land to possess.
You will live in this land.
These are the statutes and ordinances.
You must be careful to follow them.
You must do this all the days you live on the land.
passages.original: אֵ֠לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְר֣וּן לַעֲשׂוֹת֒ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֧י אֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ לְךָ֖ לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֥ם חַיִּ֖ים עַל־ הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

passages.text: Destroy completely all the places where the nations you are dispossessing have served their gods—atop the high mountains, on the hills, and under every green tree.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking to the Israelites.
God is giving them the land of Canaan.
Other nations lived in this land before.
These nations worshiped their gods in many places.
They worshiped on high mountains.
They worshiped on hills.
They worshiped under every green tree.
God commands the Israelites to destroy all these places completely.
passages.original: אַבֵּ֣ד תְּ֠אַבְּדוּן אֶֽת־ כָּל־ הַמְּקֹמ֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֧ר עָֽבְדוּ־ שָׁ֣ם הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם יֹרְשִׁ֥ים אֹתָ֖ם אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם עַל־ הֶהָרִ֤ים הָֽרָמִים֙ וְעַל־ הַגְּבָע֔וֹת וְתַ֖חַת כָּל־ עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָן׃

passages.text: Tear down their altars, smash their sacred pillars, burn up their Asherah poles, cut down the idols of their gods, and wipe out their names from every place.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to remove all traces of false worship from the land.
Tear down the altars of the nations.
Smash their sacred pillars.
Burn their Asherah poles in the fire.
Cut down the idols of their gods.
Wipe out the names of these false gods from every place.
passages.original: וְנִתַּצְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ מִזְבּחֹתָ֗ם וְשִׁבַּרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ מַצֵּ֣בֹתָ֔ם וַאֲשֵֽׁרֵיהֶם֙ תִּשְׂרְפ֣וּן בָּאֵ֔שׁ וּפְסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֖ם תְּגַדֵּע֑וּן וְאִבַּדְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ שְׁמָ֔ם מִן־ הַמָּק֖וֹם הַהֽוּא׃

passages.text: You shall not worship the LORD your God in this way.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
Do not worship the LORD your God in the same way the nations worship their gods.
Do not follow their practices.
Do not serve the LORD your God as they do.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ תַעֲשׂ֣וּן כֵּ֔ן לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Instead, you must seek the place the LORD your God will choose from among all your tribes to establish as a dwelling for His Name, and there you must go.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He will choose a place from all your tribes.
He will put His Name there.
He will make it a dwelling for Himself.
You must seek that place.
You must go there.
passages.original: כִּ֠י אִֽם־ אֶל־ הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ מִכָּל־ שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֔ם לָשׂ֥וּם אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם לְשִׁכְנ֥וֹ תִדְרְשׁ֖וּ וּבָ֥אתָ שָֽׁמָּה׃

passages.text: To that place you are to bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and heave offerings, your vow offerings and freewill offerings, as well as the firstborn of your herds and flocks.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God will choose a special place for His Name.
You must go to that place.
You must bring your burnt offerings to that place.
You must bring your sacrifices to that place.
You must bring your tithes to that place.
You must bring your heave offerings to that place.
You must bring your vow offerings to that place.
You must bring your freewill offerings to that place.
You must bring the firstborn of your herds to that place.
You must bring the firstborn of your flocks to that place.
passages.original: וַהֲבֵאתֶ֣ם שָׁ֗מָּה עֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וְזִבְחֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵת֙ מַעְשְׂרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יֶדְכֶ֑ם וְנִדְרֵיכֶם֙ וְנִדְבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּבְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקַרְכֶ֖ם וְצֹאנְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: There, in the presence of the LORD your God, you and your households shall eat and rejoice in all you do, because the LORD your God has blessed you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He will choose a special place for His Name.
You must go to that place.
You and your households will eat there.
You will eat in the presence of the LORD your God.
You will rejoice in everything you do.
The LORD your God has blessed you.
passages.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם־ שָׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם בְּכֹל֙ מִשְׁלַ֣ח יֶדְכֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם וּבָתֵּיכֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽרַכְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: You are not to do as we are doing here today, where everyone does what seems right in his own eyes.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the Israelites.
God gives them instructions.
God says, “Do not act as we act here today.”
Today, each person does what seems right to himself.
God commands them not to do this.
passages.original: לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּן כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנַ֧חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֛ים פֹּ֖ה הַיּ֑וֹם אִ֖ישׁ כָּל־ הַיָּשָׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָֽיו׃

passages.text: For you have not yet come to the resting place and the inheritance that the LORD your God is giving you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD gives you a resting place.
The LORD gives you an inheritance.
You have not yet arrived at this resting place.
You have not yet received this inheritance.
passages.original: כִּ֥י לֹא־ בָּאתֶ֖ם עַד־ עָ֑תָּה אֶל־ הַמְּנוּחָה֙ וְאֶל־ הַֽנַּחֲלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: When you cross the Jordan and live in the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and He gives you rest from all the enemies around you and you dwell securely, then the LORD your God will choose a dwelling for His Name. And there you are to bring everything I command you: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, and all the choice offerings you vow to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will give you a land as your inheritance.
You will cross the Jordan River.
You will live in the land the LORD gives you.
The LORD will give you rest from all your enemies around you.
You will live there in safety.
The LORD your God will choose a place for His Name to dwell.
You must bring everything I command you to that place.
Bring your burnt offerings there.
Bring your sacrifices there.
Bring your tithes there.
Bring your special gifts there.
Bring all the best offerings you vow to the LORD there.
passages.original: וַעֲבַרְתֶּם֮ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֣ם בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מַנְחִ֣יל אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְהֵנִ֨יחַ לָכֶ֧ם מִכָּל־ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֛ם מִסָּבִ֖יב וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם־ בֶּֽטַח׃ וְהָיָ֣ה הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֥ם בּוֹ֙ לְשַׁכֵּ֤ן שְׁמוֹ֙ שָׁ֔ם שָׁ֣מָּה תָבִ֔יאוּ אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם עוֹלֹתֵיכֶ֣ם וְזִבְחֵיכֶ֗ם מַעְשְׂרֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וּתְרֻמַ֣ת יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְכֹל֙ מִבְחַ֣ר נִדְרֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּדְּר֖וּ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates, since he has no portion or inheritance among you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
You must rejoice before Him.
You must rejoice together with your sons.
You must rejoice together with your daughters.
You must rejoice together with your male servants.
You must rejoice together with your female servants.
You must rejoice together with the Levite who lives within your gates.
The Levite has no portion or inheritance among you.
passages.original: וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵי֮ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֒ אַתֶּ֗ם וּבְנֵיכֶם֙ וּבְנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַבְדֵיכֶ֖ם וְאַמְהֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהַלֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵיכֶ֔ם כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין ל֛וֹ חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה אִתְּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Be careful not to offer your burnt offerings in just any place you see; you must offer them only in the place the LORD will choose in one of your tribal territories, and there you shall do all that I command you.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God will choose a special place for worship.
This place will be in one of your tribal territories.
Do not offer your burnt offerings anywhere you want.
Do not offer them in any place you see.
Offer your burnt offerings only in the place God chooses.
Do everything I command you in that place.
passages.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּֽן־ תַּעֲלֶ֖ה עֹלֹתֶ֑יךָ בְּכָל־ מָק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃ כִּ֣י אִם־ בַּמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בְּאַחַ֣ד שְׁבָטֶ֔יךָ שָׁ֖ם תַּעֲלֶ֣ה עֹלֹתֶ֑יךָ וְשָׁ֣ם תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּֽךָּ׃

passages.text: But whenever you want, you may slaughter and eat meat within any of your gates, according to the blessing the LORD your God has given you. Both the ceremonially clean and unclean may eat it as they would a gazelle or deer, but you must not eat the blood; pour it on the ground like water.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God has given you blessings.
You may slaughter animals whenever you desire meat.
You may eat meat within any of your gates.
This is allowed because of the blessing God has given you.
Anyone may eat this meat.
Those who are ceremonially clean may eat it.
Those who are ceremonially unclean may also eat it.
You may eat it as you would eat gazelle or deer.
You must not eat the blood.
You must pour the blood on the ground like water.
passages.original: רַק֩ בְּכָל־ אַוַּ֨ת נַפְשְׁךָ֜ תִּזְבַּ֣ח׀ וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ בָשָׂ֗ר כְּבִרְכַּ֨ת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־ לְךָ֖ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ הַטָּמֵ֤א וְהַטָּהוֹר֙ יֹאכְלֶ֔נּוּ כַּצְּבִ֖י וְכָאַיָּֽל׃ רַ֥ק הַדָּ֖ם לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ עַל־ הָאָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖נּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: Within your gates you must not eat the tithe of your grain or new wine or oil, the firstborn of your herds or flocks, any of the offerings that you have vowed to give, or your freewill offerings or special gifts.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel specific commands about worship and offerings.
God told the people where to bring certain offerings.
You must not eat the tithe of your grain within your own gates.
You must not eat the tithe of your new wine within your own gates.
You must not eat the tithe of your oil within your own gates.
You must not eat the firstborn of your herds within your own gates.
You must not eat the firstborn of your flocks within your own gates.
You must not eat any offerings you have vowed to give within your own gates.
You must not eat your freewill offerings within your own gates.
You must not eat your special gifts within your own gates.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ תוּכַ֞ל לֶאֱכֹ֣ל בִּשְׁעָרֶ֗יךָ מַעְשַׂ֤ר דְּגָֽנְךָ֙ וְתִֽירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֔ךָ וּבְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקָרְךָ֖ וְצֹאנֶ֑ךָ וְכָל־ נְדָרֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּדֹּ֔ר וְנִדְבֹתֶ֖יךָ וּתְרוּמַ֥ת יָדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Instead, you must eat them in the presence of the LORD your God at the place the LORD your God will choose—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates. Rejoice before the LORD your God in all you do, and be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.
passages.sermon:
You must eat these offerings before the LORD your God.
You must do this at the place the LORD your God will choose.
You must eat there with your son.
You must eat there with your daughter.
You must eat there with your male servant.
You must eat there with your female servant.
You must eat there with the Levite who lives in your gates.
You must rejoice before the LORD your God in everything you do.
You must be careful not to neglect the Levite.
You must remember the Levite as long as you live in your land.
passages.original: כִּ֡י אִם־ לִפְנֵי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ תֹּאכְלֶ֗נּוּ בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִבְחַ֜ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶיךָ֮ בּוֹ֒ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֤ וּבִתֶּ֙ךָ֙ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְהַלֵּוִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֗ לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶֽךָ׃ הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּֽן־ תַּעֲזֹ֖ב אֶת־ הַלֵּוִ֑י כָּל־ יָמֶ֖יךָ עַל־ אַדְמָתֶֽךָ׃ס

passages.text: When the LORD your God expands your territory as He has promised, and you crave meat and say, “I want to eat meat,” you may eat it whenever you want.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD promised to expand your land.
The LORD will make your territory larger.
You may desire to eat meat.
You may say, "I want to eat meat."
You may eat meat whenever you desire.
You may eat meat whenever you want.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יַרְחִיב֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֥יךָ אֶֽת־ גְּבֽוּלְךָ֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר־ לָךְ֒ וְאָמַרְתָּ֙ אֹכְלָ֣ה בָשָׂ֔ר כִּֽי־ תְאַוֶּ֥ה נַפְשְׁךָ֖ לֶאֱכֹ֣ל בָּשָׂ֑ר בְּכָל־ אַוַּ֥ת נַפְשְׁךָ֖ תֹּאכַ֥ל בָּשָֽׂר׃

passages.text: If the place where the LORD your God chooses to put His Name is too far from you, then you may slaughter any of the herd or flock He has given you, as I have commanded you, and you may eat it within your gates whenever you want.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD may choose a special place to put His Name.
Sometimes this place may be far from you.
The LORD your God has given you cattle and sheep.
You may slaughter your cattle and sheep, as I have commanded you.
You may eat the meat in your own towns.
You may eat whenever you desire.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יִרְחַ֨ק מִמְּךָ֜ הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִבְחַ֜ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶיךָ֮ לָשׂ֣וּם שְׁמ֣וֹ שָׁם֒ וְזָבַחְתָּ֞ מִבְּקָרְךָ֣ וּמִצֹּֽאנְךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְךָ֔ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִ֑ךָ וְאָֽכַלְתָּ֙ בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל אַוַּ֥ת נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

passages.text: Indeed, you may eat it as you would eat a gazelle or deer; both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel instructions about eating meat.
You may eat this meat the same way you eat gazelle or deer.
Anyone may eat it.
A person who is ceremonially unclean may eat it.
A person who is ceremonially clean may also eat it.
Both the unclean and the clean may eat together.
passages.original: אַ֗ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵאָכֵ֤ל אֶֽת־ הַצְּבִי֙ וְאֶת־ הָ֣אַיָּ֔ל כֵּ֖ן תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ הַטָּמֵא֙ וְהַטָּה֔וֹר יַחְדָּ֖ו יֹאכְלֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: Only be sure not to eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.
passages.sermon:
God gave this command to the Israelites.
God told them not to eat blood.
Blood is the life of the animal.
Do not eat the life with the meat.
Be very careful to obey this command.
passages.original: רַ֣ק חֲזַ֗ק לְבִלְתִּי֙ אֲכֹ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם כִּ֥י הַדָּ֖ם ה֣וּא הַנָּ֑פֶשׁ וְלֹא־ תֹאכַ֥ל הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ עִם־ הַבָּשָֽׂר׃

passages.text: You must not eat the blood; pour it on the ground like water.
passages.sermon:
God gave this command to the Israelites.
Do not eat the blood.
Pour the blood on the ground.
Pour it out like water.
passages.original: לֹ֖א תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ הָאָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖נּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave this command to His people Israel.
God told them not to eat blood.
God said, “Do not eat it.”
If you obey, it will go well with you.
It will also go well with your children after you.
You will do what is right in the eyes of the LORD.
passages.original: לֹ֖א תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ לְמַ֨עַן יִיטַ֤ב לְךָ֙ וּלְבָנֶ֣יךָ אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־ תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: But you are to take your holy things and your vow offerings and go to the place the LORD will choose.
passages.sermon:
You have holy things.
You have vow offerings.
Take your holy things.
Take your vow offerings.
Go to the place the LORD will choose.
passages.original: רַ֧ק קָֽדָשֶׁ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֖ וּנְדָרֶ֑יךָ תִּשָּׂ֣א וּבָ֔אתָ אֶל־ הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Present the meat and blood of your burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD your God. The blood of your other sacrifices must be poured out beside the altar of the LORD your God, but you may eat the meat.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
You must bring your burnt offerings to Him.
Take the meat and the blood of your burnt offerings.
Place them on the altar of the LORD your God.
Pour out the blood of your other sacrifices beside the altar of the LORD your God.
You may eat the meat of those sacrifices.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ עֹלֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ הַבָּשָׂ֣ר וְהַדָּ֔ם עַל־ מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְדַם־ זְבָחֶ֗יךָ יִשָּׁפֵךְ֙ עַל־ מִזְבַּח֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהַבָּשָׂ֖ר תֹּאכֵֽל׃

passages.text: Be careful to obey all these things I command you, so that it may always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God gives you commands.
You must obey all the things God commands you.
Be careful to do everything God says.
If you obey, things will go well for you.
Things will go well for your children after you.
This blessing will last forever.
You will do what is good in God’s eyes.
You will do what is right in God’s eyes.
passages.original: שְׁמֹ֣ר וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֑ךָּ לְמַעַן֩ יִיטַ֨ב לְךָ֜ וּלְבָנֶ֤יךָ אַחֲרֶ֙יךָ֙ עַד־ עוֹלָ֔ם כִּ֤י תַעֲשֶׂה֙ הַטּ֣וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁ֔ר בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ס

passages.text: When the LORD your God cuts off before you the nations you are entering to dispossess, and you drive them out and live in their land, be careful not to be ensnared by their ways after they have been destroyed before you. Do not inquire about their gods, asking, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will remove the nations before you.
You will enter their land.
You will take possession of their land.
You will live in their land.
Be careful.
Do not follow the ways of those nations.
Do not let their ways trap you after they are destroyed before you.
Do not ask about their gods.
Do not say, “How did these nations serve their gods?”
Do not say, “I will do the same.”
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יַכְרִית֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֥ה בָא־ שָׁ֛מָּה לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אוֹתָ֖ם מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֖ בְּאַרְצָֽם׃ הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֗ פֶּן־ תִּנָּקֵשׁ֙ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י הִשָּׁמְדָ֣ם מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וּפֶן־ תִּדְרֹ֨שׁ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶ֜ם לֵאמֹ֨ר אֵיכָ֨ה יַעַבְד֜וּ הַגּוֹיִ֤ם הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אֶת־ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־ כֵּ֖ן גַּם־ אָֽנִי׃

passages.text: You must not worship the LORD your God in this way, because they practice for their gods every abomination which the LORD hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.
passages.sermon:
You must not worship the LORD your God in the way the nations do.
The nations practice every abomination for their gods.
The LORD hates these abominations.
The nations even burn their sons and daughters in the fire for their gods.
passages.original: לֹא־ תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כֵ֔ן לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּי֩ כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֗א עָשׂוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֣י גַ֤ם אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת־ בְּנֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם יִשְׂרְפ֥וּ בָאֵ֖שׁ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: See that you do everything I command you; do not add to it or subtract from it.
passages.sermon:
God gave commands to His people Israel.
God told them to obey every command He gave.
God said, “Do everything I command you.”
Do not add anything to My commands.
Do not take anything away from My commands.
passages.original: אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֹת֥וֹ תִשְׁמְר֖וּ לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לֹא־ תֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א תִגְרַ֖ע מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃פ
